name: CrowdReviews

sources.title: Get Started — online sign-up form for a vendor campaign: 'Generate leads for $3/click'
Costs — cost-per-click model, $3/click, optional daily budget (~$20/day typical), no contract

requirements: Vendor signup is a paid traffic campaign, not a free listing: you pay $3 per click to your landing page
Sign-up form requires first/last name, email, phone number, and website URL
You configure a budget and a landing page for the campaign; both are editable after setup
Free phone support / call scheduling available (1-800-874-2458) as an alternative to online signup
preparation: Landing page URL to send paid clicks to
Daily budget decision (site suggests ~$20/day to start)
Credit card (Visa, MasterCard, or Amex accepted) for the online payment step
workflow: Fill the signup form (name, email, phone, website) and create the account
CrowdReviews connects with you to finish setup; set your budget and landing page in the interface
Link a credit card to activate the $3/click campaign
Monitor real-time click reports; adjust budget or landing page as needed
watchFor: This is a paid lead-gen channel, not a free directory listing — rankings rise 'for willing to be transparent', i.e. paying vendors rank
Any organic/free vendor presence was not visible on the pages fetched — assume paid unless a free claim route is found
Buyers-guide positioning means placement depends on client reviews, which you may need to solicit
countsAsLive: The vendor appears in the relevant CrowdReviews buyers-guide category and the click campaign begins reporting traffic
unknowns: Whether a free/basic listing exists without the $3/click campaign
How rankings are computed and whether paying vendors are labeled
Whether outbound vendor links are follow or nofollow
